title: Fake-DOM census (structural, frozen file list) + rename prompt-section-world.js → client-world.js
description:
Plan pieces 1 and 2. They land as one PR, as the plan allows and review note 7 asks, so the [CLAUDE.md:58](<http://CLAUDE.md:58>) byte arithmetic is done once.

**Census.** New `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js`, in the existing `test:unit` glob.

* **Definition (structural, parsed with** `acorn`**).** One class, function or object literal *defines* `querySelector`/`querySelectorAll` plus at least one other tree member. A tree member is `innerHTML`, `outerHTML`, `children`, `childNodes`, `classList`, `appendChild`, `insertBefore`, `removeChild`, `insertAdjacentHTML`, `parentNode`, `firstChild`, or, per review note 2, `replaceChildren`/`replaceWith`. A unit with three or more tree members is also caught. A member counts whether it is a method, a function-valued property, a getter/setter or an assignment such as `x.querySelector = …`. Review note 2 adds a third signal: a class or factory returned from a `createElement` stub that has two or more tree members (this catches `chat-render-markdown-text.test.js:49`).
* **Fixtures inside the test pin the definition.** Positive: a `makeContainer` literal; the same under the name `makeHost`; `class FakeElement` with `classList` and `children`; a post-hoc `el.querySelector = …` plus an `innerHTML` getter/setter; the `chart-helpers` shape; the `createElement`-returned shape. Negative: `{ getElementById: () => null }`; `{ querySelector: () => null }`; the vm-suite `document` shim. Change the member list only through these fixtures. Do not tune it to bring the count down (review note 1a).
* **Scope.** Every `.js`/`.mjs` under `tests/`, `scripts/eval` and `scripts/code-shape`, except `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js` and the census file. **Do not import** `stripComments` **from** `test-server-listen-bind.test.js` (review note 3): importing it re-runs that file's tests. acorn already drops comments.
* **Ratchet.** `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` is a sorted list of names. Fail if the scan finds a file that is not on the list, and fail if the list names a file the scan no longer finds. The failure message names `helpers/fake-dom.js` plus `loadWorld`, and also says how to vm-run a slice against `createFakeDom()`'s `document` (review note 1c).
* **Baseline.** Use what the scan finds, not a target. Review's prototype found about 54. Every Survey-named file must be caught; if one is missed, the rule is wrong. `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js` is expected on the list (review note 5). Record the baseline length and the list in the PR.
* **Witnesses.** Remove one name from the list (red). Add a name for a clean file (red). Drop a throwaway `makeHost` fake into `tests/unit` (red).

**Rename.** `tests/unit/helpers/prompt-section-world.js` becomes `client-world.js`. The `loadWorld` export and its behaviour stay the same. Update its 2 importers (`lin-4010-home-opened-task`, `lin-4246-opened-task-repaint-keep`), its own header (it runs whichever `public/` scripts a suite names), the `fake-dom.js` header and [CLAUDE.md:58](<http://CLAUDE.md:58>). Afterwards `git grep prompt-section-world` finds nothing.

**Docs.** Edit [CLAUDE.md:58](<http://CLAUDE.md:58>) in place so it names the census, the way the paragraph beside it names `test-server-listen-bind.test.js`. CLAUDE.md is at 110/110 lines and 11,723/12,000 bytes (`claude-md-line-budget.test.js`). The `fake-dom.js` header gains the census as its guard.

**Done when:** the census is green in `npm run test:unit` with the baseline frozen, the three witnesses are shown red, the rename is complete, the 2 importers keep the same test names and counts, and the CLAUDE.md budget test passes.

---

**Where the scope and design live.** Parent: LIN-4255. Read its description's **Implementation Plan** (the approved plan) and the Plan Review Verdict comment `98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f`, which has notes for the builder. The parent's approved plan is where this piece starts. Follow it. Where the code shows the plan is wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4255.

* Session fit: fits one session
* Plan-review due: no. Covered by LIN-4255's approving plan-review (comment 98a20bc0-f43b-406c-bb64-8ce22860b08f, rev 1).
* Grounding commit: `b5391736` (LinearViewer origin/main; still HEAD when this breakdown was made on 2026-11-05).

**Rules for every move piece (from the plan):** test names and counts stay the same. Before and after, run `node --test --test-reporter=spec <file>` and paste the empty diff. Remove each moved file from `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and from the `fake-dom.js` header's consumer list in the same PR. Delete both copies, the container and the `vm` sandbox. Never loosen an assertion that reads fake internals: map it to a real-DOM replacement and prove the replacement goes red under the mutation it guards. Every red is a finding, and the PR records it as fixed, filed or fake artefact. Serializer differences (`disabled=""`, escaping) are fixed in the test's regexes, never by relaxing the fake. Out of scope: the 7 `container.querySelector ? … : null` guards in `public/prompt-section.js`.

---

## Landed

Implemented as approved, in PR [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297>), squash commit `69e8f1754f5c1a1c38c924ce82531b1e680ee48c` on main: the structural census (`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js`, frozen 56-file `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES`), the rename `prompt-section-world.js` → `client-world.js` with its 2 importers, the `fake-dom.js` header and [CLAUDE.md:58](<http://CLAUDE.md:58>). Two deviations from the ticket text, both accepted in review: (1) `git grep prompt-section-world` still finds the two frozen, SHA-pinned evidence snapshots `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/{,pairs/}issue/LIN-4246.json`; (2) a moved suite **leaves** `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and **joins** the fake's consumer list (not "removed from both"). This description is otherwise unchanged: it holds the scope and acceptance, and the approved plan lives in LIN-4255. The full pre-close description is in the task snapshots, and the history is in the comment trail.

parent.title: The shared fake DOM becomes the one in fact: move the hand-written client test fakes onto it, with a census (LIN-4252 tidy-after)

comments.body:
**Beat 2: census scanner and fixtures (local commit `a0996367`, not pushed)**

`tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` uses acorn to find shapes. A shape is caught if it has any of these:
- `querySelector[All]` plus one tree member
- three or more tree members
- two or more tree members on whatever a `createElement` stub returns

There are 39 fixture tests, all green. Each of 9 mutations of the classifier turns at least one of them red.

- **The scan:** it reads 1,477 files. All of them parse as ES modules, with no parse errors. **56 files** are caught. That is near the review prototype's 54, and every Survey-named file is among them, including `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js`.
- **Not caught, correctly:** `client-world.js` and the 8 `class Fake*Provider` suites, which aren't DOM fakes.
- **One thing beat 3 should know:** with the createElement signal, a vm `document` shim is caught when its `createElement` returns `{ classList, appendChild }`. Examples: `brief-recap-ai-not-configured-contract.test.js:149` and `lin-4242-waiting-live.test.js:151`. I left that rule as it is rather than tuning it, per review note 1a.

The list will be frozen, with its ratchet and failure message, in beat 3.

**PR open for review: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297** (head `ab5e2210`, not merged)

**What's in it:**
- the census, `tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js`, with a frozen **56-file** `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` ratchet;
- the rename `prompt-section-world.js` → `client-world.js`;
- the `fake-dom.js` header's new guard and consumer section;
- CLAUDE.md:58, which now names the census.

The PR body has the full list, the definition, the rename spec diffs (empty; 43/43 and 4/4) and the witness tables.

**Verification:**
- Rebased cleanly onto `e4fa8d34`. The scan at the new HEAD still equals the frozen list.
- Full `npm run test:unit`: 23,573 passed, 0 failed. Census 43/43. `claude-md-line-budget` 2/2. CLAUDE.md is 110 lines and 11,802 bytes.
- CI on `ab5e2210`: **all 7 checks passed** (Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan, CI success), run https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/actions/runs/42032795576.

**For the reviewer:**
1. **`git grep prompt-section-world` is not empty after the rebase.** Main's `e4fa8d34` (LIN-4257) added two frozen, SHA-256-pinned evidence snapshots of LIN-4246's description that quote the old name: `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/{,pairs/}issue/LIN-4246.json`. I left them untouched, since rewriting them would falsify the record. Outside that folder the grep is empty. Please confirm this exception against the Done-when.
2. **Wording of the move rule:** a moved suite **leaves** `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and **joins** the fake's consumer list. The ticket said to remove it from both. Please confirm, and so should LIN-4266, LIN-4268, LIN-4269 and LIN-4271.

**Status:** this workflow has no In Review state, so LIN-4265 stays **In Progress** until review and close-out. Merge and Done are gated on a recorded Approve.

## Review — LIN-4265

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297 at head `ab5e2210` (base `e4fa8d34`). Six files changed, which matches the plan's places for pieces 1 and 2: the census, the rename, the two importers, the `fake-dom.js` header and CLAUDE.md:58. Nothing outside the plan was touched.

CI: green on `ab5e2210`. All 7 checks passed: Unit tests, E2E 1–4, Secret scan and CI success (run 42032795576).

**Re-run independently in a worktree at the head:**
- **Census:** 43/43 tests pass. `claude-md-line-budget` passes 2/2. CLAUDE.md is 110 lines and 11,802 bytes, so it stays within 110 lines and 12,000 bytes.
- **Rename witnesses:** I diffed `node --test --test-reporter=spec` output at base and at head, with durations removed. Both diffs are empty. `lin-4010-home-opened-task` has 43/43 and `lin-4246-opened-task-repaint-keep` has 4/4. The `loadWorld` file is a 90%-similarity rename that changes only the header.
- **Witness mutations. Each went red, and each was reverted:**
  - Removing `scan-retire-ui` from the list: 1 fail (stale).
  - Adding a name for a clean file: 1 fail (stale).
  - A throwaway `makeHost` in `tests/unit`: 1 fail. The message names the file, the shape and line, `helpers/fake-dom.js`, `loadWorld` and the `createFakeDom()` vm recipe.
- **Classifier mutations, my own. Each was reverted:**
  - Dropping signal 3 (`createElement`): 3 fail.
  - Ignoring member assignments (`x.querySelector = …`): 8 fail.
  - Raising `TREE_THRESHOLD` from 3 to 4: 2 fail.
  - The fixtures do pin the definition.
- **Survey coverage:** every file that defines `makeContainer` and every `FakeElement` suite is on the list, as is `tests/fixtures/observation-dom-shim.js`. The four suites that import that shim (for example `observation-scope`, `observation-waiting-host`) are correctly left off, because they use the fake and do not define one.
- **Regression check:** the recent history of `fake-dom.js`, `prompt-section-world.js` and CLAUDE.md is `d234b94a` (LIN-4252) and `b5391736` (LIN-4246). Nothing is reverted or re-applied, and LIN-4252's one-fake line in CLAUDE.md is extended, not replaced.
- **Staleness check:** since this ticket was created, main gained `e4fa8d34`, which is already the base, and `88d9607f`. Neither changes a `.js`/`.mjs` under the census scope. `git diff ab5e2210 origin/main -- tests scripts/eval scripts/code-shape` shows only the PR's own changes, and `git merge-tree` reports a clean merge.
- **Class check:** the census is the class guard itself, and its list is the bounded class. The move pieces (LIN-4266/4269/4271) own the work of shrinking it. Nothing in this PR's scope is left unhandled.

**The author's two questions:**
1. **`git grep prompt-section-world` still finds `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/{,pairs/}issue/LIN-4246.json`. This exception is accepted.** Both files are frozen evidence snapshots of LIN-4246's description, listed in that folder's `manifest.json`, and they arrived on main (`e4fa8d34`) after this ticket's Done-when was written. Rewriting them would break the manifest pins and falsify the record. They don't refer to the helper as code or docs. Outside that folder the grep is empty.
2. **Move-rule wording: the author's version is accepted.** A moved suite **leaves** `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and **joins** the fake's consumer list. This is what the header and `staleFileMessage` say, and it matches LIN-4255's "header lists its consumers, current". The move pieces should follow it. Close-out should say so once on LIN-4255; no ticket is needed.

No rulings exist for LIN-4265 (`/rulings`, `includeResolved=true`, count 0), so I raised none.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the census ratchet must hold at the commit that lands). CI ran on `ab5e2210`, but main has since moved to `88d9607f`. I checked that `88d9607f` touches nothing in the census scope and that the merge is clean, but CI has not run on the merge result. **Before the merge:** close-out runs `node --test tests/unit/fake-dom-census.test.js` on the merge of the head with main as it is at merge time, or re-checks CI after an update-branch. Right means 43/43. Wrong is any "not listed" or "no longer hand-write" failure, which would mean a suite added or moved on main in the meantime. **Rollback:** revert the squash commit of #2297. It is test-only, plus one CLAUDE.md line, and nothing persisted depends on it.
- **Inside** (the rename's Done-when, `git grep prompt-section-world` empty). Discharged by this review: the two SHA-pinned snapshots above are accepted as the only exception.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger. The census, the ratchet, the rename and the docs all meet the Done-when, and every witness and mutation I re-ran goes red. The only open item is re-running the census on the merge commit, since main moved after CI ran.

## Close-out — LIN-4265

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297, squashed as `69e8f1754f5c1a1c38c924ce82531b1e680ee48c` on main, pinned with `--match-head-commit ab5e2210` (the commit CI passed on). The census and its frozen 56-file ratchet, the `client-world.js` rename with its 2 importers, the `fake-dom.js` header and CLAUDE.md:58 all landed. Nothing deploys: the change is test-only plus one CLAUDE.md line, so there were no post-deploy steps.

**Changes I made after approval:** none. Review asked for no fixes, so the merged tree is the reviewed head `ab5e2210`.

**Ledger**
- **Inside: the census must hold at the commit that lands.** Settled. Main had moved to `88d9607f`, so I built the merge of `ab5e2210` onto it in a fresh clone (merge `aefc6e65`, clean, no conflicts) and ran `node --test` on the census, `claude-md-line-budget`, `lin-4010-home-opened-task` and `lin-4246-opened-task-repaint-keep`. All passed, 92/92 and 0 failed: census 43/43, budget 2/2, lin-4010 43/43, lin-4246 4/4. There were no "not listed" or "no longer hand-write" failures. I re-read main (`88d9607f`) and the PR (CLEAN, head unchanged) immediately before the merge.
- **Inside: `git grep prompt-section-world` empty.** Discharged in review. On the merge tree the grep finds only the two frozen evidence snapshots (`docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/{,pairs/}issue/LIN-4246.json`), which review accepted as the exception.
- **Rollback (as named in review):** revert squash commit `69e8f175`. It is test-only plus one CLAUDE.md line, and nothing persisted depends on it.
- **Outside items:** none in the ledger, so nothing was filed.

**Final CI:** the PR head `ab5e2210` had 7/7 checks green (run 42032795576). Post-merge run 42034552106 on main `69e8f175` completed with success.

**Description:** archived with `GET /brief?noRefresh=1`, and the snapshot carrying the pre-prune description was confirmed in `/snapshots`. The description held no discharged stage-artifact sections (the approved plan is in LIN-4255's description), so I only appended a short "Landed" stub and left the scope and acceptance as they were.

**Related tickets:** LIN-4266, LIN-4269 and LIN-4270 stay Todo. This ticket blocked them and they are now unblocked. The move-rule wording is recorded once on LIN-4255.

## Autopilot run summary — LIN-4265 (stepper)

**Outcome: complete and verified.** PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2297 merged as squash `69e8f1754f5c1a1c38c924ce82531b1e680ee48c`; LIN-4265 is Done.

**Kind sequence (converging):** implementation (4 warm beats, one session) → review → close-out.

**Beats (implementation)**
1. Ground + rename: `prompt-section-world.js` → `client-world.js`; both importers, header and CLAUDE.md:58 updated; empty before/after spec diffs (43/43 and 4/4). Plan-vs-code drift (the `fake-dom.js` header had no consumer list) posted on LIN-4255.
2. Census scanner (acorn, structural) + 39 fixtures; 9 classifier mutations each turned it red; scan found 56 files.
3. Frozen sorted ratchet `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` (56), four ratchet tests, failure message naming `helpers/fake-dom.js`, `loadWorld` and the vm recipe; four witnesses red; `fake-dom.js` header gained "Guard and consumers"; CLAUDE.md:58 names the census (11,802 / 12,000 bytes).
4. Rebase, full `npm run test:unit` 23,573/23,573, PR #2297, CI 7/7 green.

**Evidence I checked myself**
- PR #2297 state MERGED, base main, merge commit `69e8f175`; 6 files changed, all inside the plan.
- CI on `ab5e2210`: 7/7 success (run 42032795576). CI on the landed commit `69e8f175`: 7/7 success, push run 42034552106.
- Review comment `770e1826`: conditional Approve with one ledger item (census re-run on the merge with current main), discharged by close-out (92/92 on the merge result). Close-out comment `09e7ff2f`.
- LIN-4265 state: Done.

**Two points that were the reviewer's call, both accepted by review**
- `git grep prompt-section-world` still finds two frozen LIN-4246 evidence snapshots under `docs/papers/harbour/task-size-and-cost-evidence/2026-11-05/` (SHA-pinned in that folder's manifest, added on main after the ticket was written).
- Move-rule wording: a moved suite leaves `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` and joins the `fake-dom.js` consumer list (the ticket text said remove from both). Recorded on LIN-4255 for LIN-4266/4268/4269/4271.

**What's left:** nothing on this ticket. LIN-4266, LIN-4269 and LIN-4270 are unblocked and remain Todo. Rollback: revert `69e8f175` (test-only plus one CLAUDE.md line).

**Process note:** the beat labels did not stick on plain `POST /dispatch` (the dispatch rows show `promptName: "Prompt"`), so external progress-tracking by label will not show `beat N/4`.
